notes: PFC web cuts no longer get an off-line pierce - 4.0.7 switched the lead-in on wherever a nest had 10mm gaps and a channel had no toggle to turn it off. Stitch tabs now land per section: angle toes plus a heel, channel toes plus each end of the web, tube all four corners. Common cut can be closed again after being opened to the 10mm minimum. The nesting sheet PDF draws every bar to one shared scale. Chosen end cuts are shown in the Adjust table, Cut station, parts dock and part selector.
